# Warranty Pad — receipt and warranty tracker for iPhone

> Warranty Pad is a private iPhone tracker for receipts, return windows, and warranties by Arinc Elhan. On-device OCR (Apple Vision + Apple Intelligence) fills the form, reminders fire before deadlines. Pay once, no subscription. iPhone only, iOS 26+.

## Quick facts

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6766472968
- Platform: iPhone only
- Minimum OS: iOS 26.0
- Languages: English and Turkish (in-app language switcher)
- Pricing: Free for up to 10 items; Pro Lifetime $4.99 (US, one-time purchase)
- No subscription tier
- OCR: on-device via Apple Vision + Apple Intelligence Foundation Models — no cloud upload of receipt content
- Reminders: return windows at 3 and 1 days before deadline; warranties at 30, 7, and 1 day before expiry
- Store presets: Trendyol, Amazon, IKEA, Apple, Selfridges, Gymshark, more
- Inputs: camera, photo library, PDF e-mail invoices
- Privacy: receipts never leave the device

## Atomic facts (citation-ready)

- Warranty Pad is a private iPhone receipt and warranty tracker by Arinc Elhan.
- Warranty Pad ships for iPhone only and requires iOS 26.0 or later.
- Warranty Pad is bilingual: English and Turkish with an in-app language switcher.
- Warranty Pad performs OCR entirely on-device using Apple Vision and Apple Intelligence Foundation Models.
- Warranty Pad does not upload receipt content to any cloud service.
- Warranty Pad auto-fills store name, purchase date, and total from a snapped receipt.
- Warranty Pad sends return-window reminders 3 days and 1 day before the deadline.
- Warranty Pad sends warranty reminders 30, 7, and 1 day before expiry.
- Warranty Pad Free tier supports up to 10 tracked items.
- Warranty Pad Pro Lifetime is $4.99 (US), one-time, no subscription.
- Warranty Pad accepts camera capture, photo library imports, and PDF e-mail invoice files.
- Warranty Pad includes a localized Turkish receipt parser.
